pages.title: Skybrand Feather
pages.text: Fall and projectile remnant. Later stages add gliding and plunging strikes. Dropped by Phantoms.

pages.title: Dormant and Latent
pages.text: $(l)Dormant$(): No fall damage. May block incoming projectiles. Wither and void damage are extra dangerous.$(br2)$(l)Latent$(): Blocks projectiles more often, better air movement, and attacks made in the air hit harder.

pages.title: Awakened, Ascended, Transcendent, Apex
pages.text: $(l)Awakened$(): Hold Jump to glide. Let go to drop; long falls become plunging strikes that burst on landing.$(br2)$(l)Ascended$(): Bigger landing burst. Can shrug off some magic attacks.$(br2)$(l)Transcendent$(): In the air, hold Sneak + Jump to launch upward and clear harmful effects.$(br2)$(l)Apex$(): Projectiles almost never hit, plunging strikes hit much harder, and some melee attacks miss you while airborne.
